fields.hook: One of the three people behind this AI community runs a fabrication shop.
fields.body:
This one is for the owner who types quotes in the truck between jobs.
Operators Workshop is run by three of us.
Julianna and I run an online shop. Daniel runs a fabrication shop and an operations software company.
Inside there are two tracks: Build with AI, for tools, websites, content and automations, and AI + Business Tactics, to find and keep customers, simplify operations and understand your numbers.
It is about running the business.
